scope: Every available 2026-10-11 domain-parameters-initial/final, physics-diagnostic and operator-stop JSON; every top-level *master.log, saved frozen execution plan and small first 0.6 m/s OOM stdout. Complements, and does not replace or change, evaluation-data.tar.gz.
excluded: Large simulation stdout/Kit logs including multi-gigabyte logs, resources and unrelated launch logs, TensorBoard, video, simulator binaries, system configuration and credentials.
restore: Extract evaluation-data.tar.gz and this archive into a new source checkout. Readbacks retain isaaclab/logs paths; launch metadata extracts to CHECKOUT/restored-launchlogs. Pass that directory as --run-log-root.
